about: The registry of facts (GR-11). Every fact a rule, operator or tool may read is registered here with its scope, type, unit and the kinds of source that may supply it; a computed fact says how and from what. Input files use these names. CC, 2026-11-01. The draft 4.2 extension (dimensions, the name lint) is parked with the ontology (L25).

source_kinds.capture: measured on site (Yardstick), with a tolerance
source_kinds.official_record: a public record or map from the issuing agency (names its issuer)
source_kinds.plan_document: the plan set for the structure
source_kinds.entered: typed in by a named person, with what it rests on
source_kinds.computed: derived by a named tool or formula from other facts

markers_not_facts: unrecognised: no fact in the lexicon matches these words; read the clause

facts.name: site.zone
facts.description: The lot's base zone (Portland RF..R2.5; Eugene R-1..R-4).

facts.name: site.zone_family
facts.description: The family of the base zone.

computed.how: single_dwelling for RF through R2.5 (Portland 33.110.020) and R-1 (Eugene 9.2700)

facts.description: The lot abuts an alley.

facts.description: Trees at or over Title 11's diameter thresholds are on or near the site.

facts.name: site.slope_pct

facts.name: site.historic_resource
facts.description: The lot holds a designated historic resource or is in a historic or conservation district.

facts.name: plan.kind
facts.description: What is being placed.

facts.name: plan.detached

facts.name: plan.outline

facts.name: plan.wall_height_ft

facts.name: plan.living_area_sqft
facts.description: The ADU's living area (33.910.030 Living Area).

facts.name: plan.eave_ft

facts.description: Parking spaces the plan adds.

facts.name: plan.is_cistern

facts.description: The structure has gable walls.

facts.name: plan.dormers
facts.description: The structure has dormers.

facts.name: plan.rooftop_deck
facts.description: The structure has a rooftop deck.

facts.name: plan.openings_facing_lot_line

facts.name: plan.basement_conversion
facts.description: The ADU is a converted basement of the primary dwelling.

facts.name: plan.vacation_occupancy
facts.description: The unit is for vacation occupancy.

facts.name: plan.owner_occupancy_required
facts.description: An owner-occupancy requirement is imposed.

facts.name: plan.sloped_ceiling
facts.description: Part of the ADU's floor area sits under a ceiling lower than 5 feet (33.910.030 Living Area's attic exclusion).

facts.name: plan.openings_by_face
facts.description: The plan faces (front, rear, left, right; curated/conventions.json plan_frame) that have doors or windows. 33.110.245.C.2.b.(6) reads it per wall within the setback, after rotation.

facts.name: plan.dormer_faces
facts.description: The plan faces that carry dormers, with each dormer's setback from the nearest side or rear lot line once placed. 33.110.245.C.2.b.(8).

facts.name: plan.total_building_sqft
facts.description: Eugene 9.2751(17)(a)1.: the accessory dwelling's total building square footage, measured at the exterior perimeter walls, all square footage inside the dwelling (hallways, entries, closets, utility rooms, stairways, bathrooms); up to 300 sq ft of attached unheated storage is not counted (9.2751(17)(b)1.).

facts.name: plan.accessory_dwellings_on_lot
facts.description: Eugene 9.2741(3): how many accessory dwellings the lot will have for its detached single-unit dwelling if this plan is built (existing ones plus the planned one). Counted by the owner or from records, never by the model.
